# Paths excluded from the secret scan, as extended-regex patterns matched against the
# repo-relative file path. Every entry here is a MEASURED false positive from an observed
# run of this job (Actions runs 33751423659, 2026-09-03, and 36429830379, 2026-09-28), not a
# speculative suppression. Keep this list narrow: an exact path, never a directory wildcard.
#
# Measured findings this file suppresses, by detector:
#   3x FlatIO   -> yarn.lock                       (dependency integrity hashes)
#   1x Gitlab   -> .yarn/releases/yarn-4.13.0.cjs  (the vendored Yarn release bundle)
#   1x PrivateKey -> tests/tests/support/mock-oidc-key.pem
#   1x CustomRegex (OpenVAACIEvidenceToken) -> 163-RESEARCH.md, the last entry below (run 36429830379)
#
# On the .pem: it is a throwaway 2048-bit RSA keypair generated for the LOCAL mock OIDC
# issuer (tests/tests/support/mockOidcIssuer.ts) that the bank-auth E2E suite runs against.
# Nothing real trusts it and it authenticates nothing. It is excluded so the scan baseline
# is zero -- which is what makes a planted secret's red ATTRIBUTABLE to the plant. Without
# a zero baseline the job is red before anything is planted, and criterion 3's second half
# ("removing it clears the job") can never be observed.
#
# On 163-RESEARCH.md: line 320 is the documented EXAMPLE of the planted CI-evidence line, a
# run of `a` characters under a comment that reads "NOT A REAL CREDENTIAL". The repo-private
# OpenVAACIEvidenceToken detector matches its shape by design, because the example shows what
# to plant. It is the only finding in that file.
